text:
Here's the kitchen packing plan. Pack in this order, starting with the stuff you won't need until Portland.

**Pack first (weeks before move day)**

These go into boxes K-01 through K-03 and can be sealed early.

Baking supplies and specialty tools (rolling pin, cookie sheets, cake pans, pie dishes), seasonal dishes and serving platters, cookbooks, small appliances you rarely use (stand mixer, blender, food processor, waffle maker), extra utensils and gadgets in the back of drawers, vases, candles, and decorative items, and duplicate or spare items like extra can openers or measuring cups.

**Pack second (about one week out)**

These go into boxes K-04 through K-06.

Most pots and pans (keep one skillet and one pot out), most dishes and glasses (keep two of each out), Tupperware and storage containers, cutting boards (keep one out), dish towels and oven mitts (keep one of each out), spices and dry goods (tape lids shut and bag them), and cleaning supplies under the sink (keep one spray bottle and a sponge out).

**Pack third (two to three days out)**

These go into boxes K-07 and K-08.

The remaining dishes, glasses, and silverware except two sets, the remaining pots and the skillet, the cutting board, the dish towel and oven mitt, trash bags (keep a few out), and the last of the pantry food.

**Do not pack (keep in the car, first-night box)**

This rides with you in the car and is the first thing you open in Portland.

Coffee maker or pour-over and filters, two mugs, two plates, two bowls, two forks, two knives, two spoons, one sharp knife, one pot (for boiling water or heating soup), one pan, paper towels and a roll of trash bags, dish soap and a sponge, a few zip-lock bags, salt, pepper, sugar, tea bags or instant coffee, a corkscrew or bottle opener, pet food and Milo's bowls, and snacks and bottled water for the drive.

**Packing tips for the kitchen**

Wrap each plate individually in packing paper and stack vertically like records, not flat. Glasses go upside down in cell boxes or wrapped individually with paper stuffed inside. Nest pots and pans with paper between them. Tape spice lids shut, then bag each jar in a zip-lock in case it leaks. Knives go in a rolled towel or blade guards, never loose in a box. Label one box "OPEN FIRST - KITCHEN" and mark it on the inventory sheet as K-FIRST so the movers know.
